title: Iterative Refinement Diffusion for Super-Resolved Data Assimilation of Multiscale Physical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.14744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recovering high-resolution states from sparse, low-resolution observations is a central challenge in scientific machine learning and data assimilation. Classical data assimilation exploits temporal information through forecast-analysis cycles, but often requires repeated access to expensive high-resolution forecast models. Generative super-resolution can recover unresolved structure from coarse observations, but is commonly used as a one-shot mapping that does not fully exploit constraints from past states. We introduce Iterative Refinement (IR), a learned data assimilation framework that combines these perspectives. Instead of performing a single coarse-to-fine reconstruction, IR decomposes the task into resolution-wise forecast-analysis operations across a multiresolution hierarchy. translated_title: 多尺度物理系统的超分辨率数据同化的迭代细化扩散方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14744v1 公告类型：新 摘要：从稀疏、低分辨率的观测中恢复高分辨率状态是科学机器学习和数据同化中的一个核心挑战。经典数据同化通过预报-分析循环利用时间信息，但通常需要反复访问昂贵的高分辨率预报模型。生成式超分辨率可以从粗观测中恢复未解析结构，但通常作为一种一次性映射使用，未能充分利用过去状态的约束。我们引入了迭代细化（IR），一种结合这些视角的学习型数据同化框架。IR并非执行单一从粗到细的重建，而是将任务分解为跨多分辨率层次的逐分辨率预报-分析操作。在每个阶段，一个带有分辨率相关谱模式切片的共享神经算子提供动力学先验，同时一个共享的条件扩散模型共同完成细化。
tldr: 本文提出了一种迭代细化扩散框架，通过多分辨率层次上的共享神经算子和条件扩散模型，将数据同化与生成式超分辨率结合，实现从稀疏观测中恢复高分辨率状态。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an iterative refinement diffusion framework that integrates data assimilation with generative super-resolution via shared neural operators and conditional diffusion across a multiresolution hierarchy, enabling high-resolution state recovery from sparse observations.
